FROM crucible-base:py311
WORKDIR /work
RUN ["bash","-lc","rm -rf /work/repo && git clone https://github.com/TSTS13/Paloma.git /work/repo && cd /work/repo && git checkout def3dfc612bd6554be8f2ed7d5174848d6a37119"]
RUN ["bash","-lc","mkdir -p /work/dataset/ETT-small && cd /work/dataset/ETT-small && curl -fL --retry 3 -o ETTh1.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouhaoyi/ETDataset/main/ETT-small/ETTh1.csv && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
p='/work/dataset/ETT-small/ETTh1.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
print('shape:', df.shape)
print('columns:', list(df.columns))
print('first date:', df['date'].iloc[0], 'last date:', df['date'].iloc[-1])
PY
sha256sum /work/dataset/ETT-small/ETTh1.csv"]
RUN ["bash","-lc","mkdir -p /work/paper && cd /work/paper && (curl -fL --retry 2 -o source.tar.gz https://export.arxiv.org/e-print/2610.25392 || true) && (curl -fL --retry 2 -o paper.pdf https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25392 || true) && ls -lh /work/paper && file /work/paper/* 2>/dev/null"]
limitations: Scope: four numbers only (MSE and MAE on ETTh1, horizon 96, with lookback 336 and 720). This is not a check of the whole paper.
Single run per setting on CPU with the repository's default seed (2024) and the paper's 30 epochs. No variance estimate, so small differences are within normal run-to-run noise.
Measured values are 0.0% to 1.9% from the claimed ones; 'reproduced' means within 2%.
The baselines used for 'still beats the paper's reported baselines' are the numbers printed in the paper, not re-run by Crucible.

The run was driven by an automated agent using a free open model (minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free). It did not edit the authors' model or evaluation code, but its final commands add two inline compatibility shims: np.Inf = np.inf (NumPy 2) and forcing torch.load to map_location=cpu.

Not replay-verified: the recorded Dockerfile contains only setup steps (clone, data download) and not the training, so 'crucible rerun' cannot yet reproduce these numbers from a fresh container. A replayable re-run is planned.
